summary: Anterix Inc. filed an 8-K/A to correct a bullet point in a Fact Sheet disclosing a spectrum license sale agreement between its subsidiary PDV Spectrum Holding Company and Public Utility District No. 1 of Benton County. PDV will sell a 10MHz 900 MHz broadband license covering Benton County, Washington, contingent on FCC grant of a broadband license transferable to Benton PUD. The original Fact Sheet erroneously included a $13 million total contract price from a prior customer; corrected terms are not restated. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or price per share is disclosed. Watch for FCC approval timing and spectrum transfer mechanics.
